name: MKTG 3454
title: Sales Management and Leadership
description: (Also offered as BADM 3454.) This course provides an introduction to sales force management. Students learn to effectively work within, manage, and ultimately lead in a dynamic sales force environment from the perspectives of sales operations, sales management, sales strategy, and sales leadership. Students gain experience in executing practical selling and engagement techniques in a professional selling situation.
requirement_description: MKTG 3101 or BADM 3750; open only to business majors of junior or higher status.
